name: Osakabe Kokoro
source:
A young man whose family background and upbringing are the complete opposite of Kuze and Yuri. He is a colleague of Kuze, and is well known throughout the company as a talented young man in the Engineering Department. He is a hard worker and doesn't want Kuze to know how much he hates to lose, but...

[Translated from the [url=http://pro-page.jp/fpp/uuudiary-disk/character.html]Official Website[/url]]
